caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted pendulum clock with three weights suspended by strings. The clock face is mostly rectangular with a rounded arch at the top, featuring Roman numerals for the hours and Arabic numerals for the minutes, both in black. The hands of the clock are ornate and point to a time between 9:00 and 10:00. The clock face is decorated with small floral patterns in red, orange, green, and yellow, located at the corners and around the arch. Inside the arch is a small, circular scene showing two yellow-garbed figures by a campfire with trees and hills in the background. The case of the clock, forming its body beneath the face, is painted a dark brown or near-black color, with a gently curved silhouette. From the bottom of the clock hang three cords: two weights, which are cylindrical and dark in color, and a spherical pendulum bob, also dark, with an associated cord. The background is plain and light beige, with no other objects or decorations present.
title: Clock
